newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha firm as screen rises, market tight.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha firm as screen rises, market tight.

text.p: NWE naphtha was firmer on Thursday as futures screens rose, traders said.
The market was tight. A little paraffinic material was heard available out of Scandinavia and Russian full-range cargoes are also on offer.
Demand was limited in northwest Europe although traders said there was better interest for product in the Mediterranean.
Sept swaps moved with futures although they were talked at around $195/$196 cif NWE in late business.
